newsitem.title: GREECE: ATTICA ENTER UPS DIVIDEND, EYES RIGHTS ISSUE.
newsitem.headline: ATTICA ENTER UPS DIVIDEND, EYES RIGHTS ISSUE.

text.p: Shipper Attica Enterprises said its 1996 consolidated pretax profit rose 31.5 percent to 4.029 billion drachmas from 3.063 a year earlier.
Turnover also rose to 14 billion drachmas from 9.08 billion in 1995, it said.

Attica Enterprises which operates the Superfast ferries in the Greece - Italy route said its dividend payout will amount to 1.124 billion drachmas or a net dividend per share of 40 drachmas, up 60 percent on 1995.
Management will present plans for a rights issue at the upcoming annual shareholders meeting on May 2. The size and terms of the issue will be announced then, the company said.

It said the construction of its new fleet additions, Superfast III and IV, was proceeding according to plan at Kvaerner Masa shipyards in Finland and delivery was expected in the first quarter of 1998. --George Georgiopoulos, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
